items.title: Supplier CAPA notice · lots 4412–4419
items.note: Failure mode, lot codes, unit counts and photographs attached. 30-day corrective deadline.

diff.after: CAPA-2419 issued: seam separation and zip failure, 1,240 units in lots 4412–4419, corrective plan due Oct 4.

diff.before: None held.
diff.after: $2,800 held against the next invoice, released if the corrective plan is accepted.

diff.before: Standard AQL sampling.
diff.after: Tightened inspection on the next two inbound lots from this supplier.

items.detailFoot: Requires a human signature even at the Auto dial · Realify never signs a supplier notice

diff.after: Straight to pallet liquidation at the standing quote. No idle time.

items.title: Return-less refund rule enabled at $14
items.note: Where recoverable value is under the threshold, refund without requesting the unit back.

diff.before: Every return requires an inbound shipment and inspection.
diff.after: Units with recoverable value under $14 are refunded in place — no label issued.

diff.before: Not applicable.
diff.after: Maximum two per customer per 90 days; never on a fraud-flagged account.

items.detailFoot: Saves $6.20 per unit in freight and inspection

diff.after: 32ECT with a corrugated divider whenever apparel and ceramics ship together.

diff.after: Pack ceramics separately when the order also contains apparel.

data.rqTitle: Arms when the first change applies
data.rqCopy: On apply, Realify schedules a 45-day check on the fit cohort. No improvement means the story comes back to your queue instead of being closed.
data.suppressNote: Nothing is suppressed until that item is published.
